questions.q: You can see the Great Wall of China from the Moon.
questions.note: It is far too thin to see from the Moon.
It's the closest star to Earth.

questions.q: A day on Venus is longer than its year.
There is no gravity in space.
questions.note: Gravity is everywhere, even in orbit.

questions.q: Footprints on the Moon can last for millions of years.
questions.note: There is no wind on the Moon to blow them away.
